title: Hops to Conclusions
description: Hops to Conclusions — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Lieutenant

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: The Lieutenant wants to know how widespread these secret Squeakeasys are and how big a problem Fizz Water consumption is. Frisk some Whisker bosses and see if they're part of the conspiracy.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Townston Lieutenant

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Hops to Conclusions

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: The Lieutenant wants to know how widespread these secret Squeakeasys are and how big a problem Fizz Water consumption is. Frisk some Whisker bosses and see if they're part of the conspiracy.

Offer:

We need to see how big this illegal Fizz Water operation is. Your discovery of those suspicious doors was a boon to the investigation. We had heard rumors of Secret Squeakeasys being set-up around Algernon. Whiskers have been selling their FizzStar in these Squeakeasys to anyone that wants it. Agents have seen Whiskers, Mutants and even some of these strange huge new rats coming out of these doors. And when they come out they look all hyper and are bouncing off the walls. And the smell! They smell like they've been soaking in one of Audrey's select colognes.

I bet these new doors lead to the Squeakeasys! We need more information but we can't find a Whisker willing to rat anyone out.

Head down into Algernon and frisk some of the Bossrats. We need to know what they know--maybe one of them will squeak. You might need to venture deeper into Algernon to find enough bosses.

Also, here's a hint: Whiskers don't enjoy being frisked with swords.

Turn-in:

It looks like your bad cop, bad cop routine worked. Good work! Next step is to infiltrate one of these Squeakeasys and shut it down. We need to let the Whiskers know the Kingdom is serious about Disallowance.

Objectives:

  • ''Frisked'' Whisker Broodling Bossrat
  • ''Frisked'' Whisker Blademaster Bossrat

Client level range: 5–20
